scope: Historical GSE245309 brain-CD45+ phagocyte-to-microglia benchmark, frozen official v3 backbone plus fold-fitted ridge; no new independent paired blood-brain test.
input_policy: Identical historical log1p(CP10K) mapped full-coordinate vectors, no additional assay mask; deterministic posterior-mean inference; same seed42 sample of 128 source cells. v3 adds fixed CTRL disease condition to mouse/Mono/Micro; LPS is never encoded as AD. This is the fixed legacy external benchmark, not a new population-distribution evaluation.
